rca of the issue: Bug 1 (M.Tech table) — RCA: processor.program_short() at /app/backend/processor.py:934-941 only matches keyword strings 'Bachelor'/'Master of Computer'/'Master'. The frontend ProgrammePicker submits the canonical short form ('M.Tech', 'B.Tech', 'MCA'), none of which contain those keywords, so the function falls through to 'PROG'. Then _grade_table_for_program() at line 980 checks `program_short(program) == 'M. TECH'` → False → returns B.Tech table. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/uploads/excel with program=M.Tech, then assert 'Outstanding' in extracted PDF text — fails. Mitigation: replace the keyword chain with `p = program.upper().replace(' ','').replace('.','')` then map 'MTECH'/'MASTER'→'M. TECH', 'MCA'/'MASTEROFCOMPUTER'→'MCA', 'BTECH'/'BACHELOR'→'B. TECH'. Bug 2 (GS Director missing) — RCA: generate_gs_pdf appends [grade_reference_block, signature_table] to the story without a KeepTogether or PageBreak guard. ReportLab splits a frame whenever the next flowable doesn't fit. For 12-subject students, the cumulative height of header+student-info+12-row subject table+totals+grade-ref(13 rows)+signature exceeds A4 portrait height (842pt). The signature flows to a new page, but new students PageBreak immediately to start their own page → many students' GS first page never renders the signature. Mitigation: wrap [grade_reference_block, signature_table] inside KeepTogether and reduce grade-ref font to 6pt; or render grade-ref ONLY on a single appendix page at end of GS doc.
